items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: What molecular account of the local B/O/P structural differences between phosphonate–borane2a and its dealkylated lithium salt is supported by the crystallographic observations and a defensible model investigation? Determine what can be attributed within the studied models and where experimental environment or model representation limits the conclusion.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. Conclusions concern the full experimental identities or explicitly labeled approximations. A methyl-truncated model does not automatically establish the geometry of the full Cy/OEt lithium salt. Finite structures do not prove solution aggregation, reaction kinetics, solubility, electrolyte performance or thermal robustness. A gas-phase model and a crystal are different physical environments.
